**End of Life Notice**

This software will reach EOL in the next few weeks. After that and a final update, it’ll still be available as a free, unsupported version for everyone to enjoy.

Thanks so much to everyone who’s used my tweaks in the past 6 years. ❤️ You’ve made it a fun ride :)

-tomt000, 2025.04.21

   


**Dynamic Stage** is the modern reimagining of Stage Manager for iPhone, offering a blend with Dynamic Island. With its seamless integration into iOS, you can expect **fluid gestures and animations** that elevate your **multitasking** experience.

   
**Compatible from iOS 14.X to iOS 16.X (rootful & rootless, no serotonin) on iPhone**  


Check out the reveal video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EfgQI7DaiSo

   
🌠 Dive into one app without the need to quit the other. Whether you're looking to enter the split view mode for simultaneous app usage or simply use the stage as an overlay for quick glances, Dynamic Stage ensures efficient and **effortless navigation.**

↖️ Swipe up from the bottom right to access the stage. From this point, you can simply release your finger to launch the stage or drag it beneath your current app to activate **Split View**. Choose any app; it will remain open even if you minimize the stage by pulling it down from its top edge. To close the app, simply swipe up from the bottom right while within the stage.

🛠 You can customize settings for each app, allowing them to launch in iPad mode. This facilitates dynamic resizing of the app without needing a relaunch (provided the app supports this feature). Due to size limitations, some apps, particularly certain games, may not operate at their best within the stage. Nevertheless, rest assured that many apps do function well. 
If an app does not work well within Dynamic Stage, you can always disable it from showing up in the app list.

Camera isn't accessible within the Stage  
Keyboard behavior may vary in certain apps  
Stage is not available in landscape orientation
